long_biography.plain_text:
Knight Global grew from a three-person Michigan workshop into a producer of ergonomic material-handling equipment. Its catalogue now spans arms, balancers, controls, lift assists, servo systems and industrial tractors. James Zaguroli Jr. helped connect that expansion to engineering, pairing corporate leadership with the development of devices intended to make factory lifting safer and more precise.

In a mid-1990s account of Knight's supplier relationships, Zaguroli emphasised technical progress, crediting a valve partner with staying several product generations ahead. Official patent records reinforce that practical focus: his work includes safety arrangements, automatic lubrication and cable management for hoists. Knight has since broadened its customer base beyond automotive plants to aviation, construction and food production.
